def solution():
    # EUR amount covered by the forward contract
    eur_amount = 200_000 * 90

    # A long EUR share position is hedged by selling EUR forward.
    initial_forward_bid = 1.3935 - 19.0 / 10_000
    three_month_forward_bid = 1.4106 - 21.6 / 10_000

    # Discount the cost of closing the remaining three-month forward.
    usd_libor = 1.266 / 100
    time_to_maturity = 3 / 12
    undiscounted_cost = eur_amount * (three_month_forward_bid - initial_forward_bid)
    termination_cost = undiscounted_cost / (1 + usd_libor * time_to_maturity)

    return round(termination_cost, 1)
